_readme: The Check Engine known-crash list. Each entry is a crash that was already solved or seen again and again, with its fix. 'all': every text must be in the crash report; 'any': at least one must be; 'none': none may be. First match wins, so put narrow entries above broad ones. Raise 'version' with every change. Each Check Engine jar ships its own copy and never downloads it: new entries reach players with the next Check Engine version.

crashes.title: RivaTuner / MSI Afterburner overlay
crashes.detail: The game died inside RivaTuner Statistics Server, the on-screen FPS overlay that comes with MSI Afterburner. It hooks into the game's graphics and modded Minecraft often trips over it.
crashes.fix: Close RivaTuner Statistics Server (or turn its overlay off for javaw.exe), then start the game again.

crashes.title: Discord overlay
crashes.detail: The game died inside Discord's in-game overlay.
crashes.fix: Turn off Discord's in-game overlay (Discord settings > Game Overlay), then start the game again.

crashes.title: No proper graphics driver
crashes.detail: Windows has no OpenGL driver for the graphics card the game is using, usually because only Windows' basic display driver is installed.
crashes.fix: Install the driver from your graphics card maker (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel), restart the PC, then start the game. On a laptop, make javaw.exe use the dedicated graphics card.
any: WGL: The driver does not appear to support OpenGL

crashes.title: Java couldn't get the memory you gave it
crashes.detail: The launcher asked Java for more memory than it could reserve. This happens with 32-bit Java, or when the RAM setting is higher than the PC can spare.
crashes.fix: Lower the RAM setting in your launcher (6 to 8 GB is plenty for most packs) and make sure the launcher uses 64-bit Java.
any: Could not reserve enough space for

crashes.title: Create contraption collision crash with Sable
crashes.detail: A Create contraption crashed while working out a collision, with Sable (and Aeronautics, if installed) also changing how contraptions collide. This crash shows up again and again in reports with these mods together.
crashes.fix: Update Sable, Aeronautics and Create to their newest versions together. If it still happens, send this crash report to Sable's issue tracker and stay away from the contraption that crashed until then.

crashes.title: Sable's physics library couldn't load
crashes.detail: Sable uses a native physics library (Rapier) that has to load on your computer. Here it failed to load. Reports show this mostly on Macs with Apple chips.
crashes.fix: Update Sable to its newest version. If it still fails, send this crash report to Sable's issue tracker; until it's fixed, this modpack can't run with Sable on this computer.
